messages:
Maya: hey folks — planning a small LAN/Steam Deck hang in the mezzanine Sat night. low-key, bring whatever you want to play. who needs to borrow a deck or battery pack?
Luis: i'm in. could use a battery pack — my Deck dies in ~2hrs with Wi‑Fi + streaming. anyone got recs for portable PSUs?
Derek: Anker 65W packs are solid. i usually bring a 100W if i'm on-site cause multiple devices.
Kim: heads-up — if people plan to plug lots of laptops into the breaker, let's avoid space heaters and kettles :grimacing: Also, can someone bring an ethernet switch? Wi‑Fi might be flaky if lots of devices join.
Maya: good call. Derek, can you bring your switch?
Derek: yup i've got a 5-port gigabit. i'll also bring a short CAT6 and label it.
Luis: quick poll — react with :one: for Rocket League, :two: for Jackbox, :three: for Among Us as the warm-up.
Kim: logistics Q — are guests allowed? not sure on access card rules on weekends.
OpsBot: Space policy reminder: mezzanine is available for internal events only. Guests must be escorted by an employee at all times. Please register visitors with People Ops ahead of time.
Maya: noted, we'll keep it internal unless someone registers.
Derek: i can bring spare controllers: 2x Xbox, 1x PS4, and 1 wired SN30 Pro. controllers are communal but please label if personal.
Luis: also have a spare USB‑C->USB‑A cable if anyone needs to hotplug a Deck for charge.
Kim: meme alert — someone said “power strip olympics” when i mentioned adapters. please don't do power strip olympics. :joy:
Maya: haha noted. i'll bring a proper surge protector and some gaffer tape for cable management.
Luis: who wants to try an impromptu mini-tourney for the Steam key i'm donating? small prize: winner buys the next pizza.
Derek: i'll enter for comedic value. terrible but enthusiastic.
Maya: tallying volunteers. i'll post a tiny checklist tomorrow: controllers, chargers, switch, ethernet, surge protector, snacks. anyone wanna bring snacks besides me?
Kim: chips here. someone grab sweets for the late-night crowd.
Maya: perfect. setup ~18:30, start 19:00. we'll expand the couch area if more show. cleanup after is everyone.
Luis: thanks for organizing Maya! :heart:
